reason: "Ausbildung" is vocational/educational training; it comes from an Amazon-Translate heading ("## Ausbildung") in d2l-de, whose own body text says "Trainingsfunktion ... trainieren". Model training is "Training" (das).

"Validierungs-Dataset" is Google MT house style (Dataset left untranslated); the glossary renders dataset as "Datensatz". Alt.: Validierungsmenge.
"Trainingsdaten" is "training data", not the set; align with dataset = Datensatz. Keep "Trainingsdaten"/"Trainingsmenge" as alternatives.
As training-set: "Testdaten" is "test data". Alt.: Testmenge, Testdaten.

"Ebene" is Google MT for layer (UI/graphics sense); the glossary's layer is "Schicht". Wikipedia: "versteckte Schicht (englisch hidden layer)", also "verdeckte Schichten". Adjective must match hidden-state / hidden-unit.
One adjective for "hidden" across hidden layer/state/unit (currently versteckt vs. verborgen). Native reviewer to pick versteckt / verborgen / verdeckt once.

"Testsfehlerrate" is malformed (spurious linking -s) and means "error rate"; siblings are Validierungsfehler, Generalisierungsfehler.
"-rate" narrows the sense to a classification error rate; align with Validierungsfehler / Generalisierungsfehler.
"Reduktion von Dimensionen" is a paraphrase from a bachelor-thesis word list; the established compound is "Dimensionsreduktion".
"Vorzeitiges Beenden" is Google MT (reads like aborting a program). German ML usage keeps "Early Stopping" (das); alt. "frühzeitiges Stoppen".
Borderline: "Feinabstimmung" exists (Wikipedia uses "feinabgestimmt") but also means generic tuning; LLM practice says "Fine-Tuning" (das). Keep "Feinabstimmung" as alternative. Author decision.
"Lernen im Kontext" (Google MT) reads as ordinary prose, not as a term. Alt.: In-Context-Learning.
Term is usable, but the cited evidence (Google responsible-AI glossary) defines human implicit/cognitive bias, not the optimizer-induced preference meant here. Demote; no same-sense source.
"Schätzung" is the estimation procedure and collides with maximum-likelihood-estimation; the estimator is "Schätzer" (the estimate: "Schätzwert").
Klassifikation vs. Klassifizierung: the glossary uses Klassifikation everywhere else (Klassifikation, Bildklassifikation, Textklassifikation).
Compounds in the glossary use "Netz" (rekurrentes neuronales Netz, Residualnetz, Score-Netz); Wikipedia lemma is "Künstliches neuronales Netz", "Netzwerk" is the secondary form.

Policy decision rather than an error: "Fehlerrückführung" is attested (Wikipedia gives "Fehlerrückführung (engl. Backpropagation)") but teaching and practice say "Backpropagation" (die). Keep "Fehlerrückführung" as alternative.
k/c spelling: the glossary has Positionskodierung, Quellenkodierung, Arithmetische Kodierung, Dekodierung but One-Hot-Codierung, Kanalcodierung. Pick one (suggest k; Encoder/Decoder stay as loans).
Acronym must stay Latin (die GPU); "Grafikprozessor" at 1,195 occurrences is not how any German ML text refers to GPUs.
"Kritiker-generativ" is the concept ID leaking into the term; the GAN critic is "Kritiker" (same word as the RL critic, disambiguated by context).

Statistics German: "Verzerrung" of an estimator (alt. Bias); pairs with the glossary's own "erwartungstreuer Schätzer". Frees "Bias" for the layer offset. Fixed phrases may keep Bias (Bias-Varianz-Zerlegung, induktiver Bias).

Kernel vs. Kern: glossary has Kernel (conv), Kerngröße, Kernfunktion, Kernelmatrix, Übergangskern. Suggested rule: mathematical kernels = "Kern" (Faltungskern, Kernfunktion, Kernmatrix, Übergangskern); GPU/CUDA kernel = "Kernel". Alt.: Kernel (Wikipedia CNN article: "Faltungsmatrix", "Kernel").
Align with Kernfunktion (same covariance-kernel sense).
Sense is the posterior *distribution*; "A-posteriori-Wahrscheinlichkeit" is a probability (and duplicates posterior-probability). Alt.: Posterior (der).

Prior/posterior family is rendered five different ways (Prior-Verteilung, Priorwahrscheinlichkeit, Konjugierte Priorverteilung, A-posteriori-..., Posteriorer ...). Use A-priori-/A-posteriori- compounds, short forms "Prior"/"Posterior" as alternatives.

"Stichprobenziehung" is the survey-statistics sense; drawing from a model/distribution is "Sampling" (das), as the glossary itself has in Gibbs-Sampling, Importance Sampling, Langevin-Sampling, Negatives Sampling. Keep "Stichprobenziehung" as alternative for the statistical sense.
"Stichprobe" is a statistical sample (a set of observations); a generated sample is "Sample" (das) or "erzeugtes Beispiel".
See sample-quality.
"Saubere Stichprobe" = a clean statistical sample; here a single uncorrupted data point. Alt.: unverrauschtes Beispiel.
"Gleichgerichtete lineare Einheit" is a word-for-word rendering nobody uses (562 occurrences). German texts write "ReLU" / "Rectified Linear Unit".

"Langzeit-Kurzzeit-Gedächtnis" misparses the name (it is a long *short-term* memory: Wikipedia "langes Kurzzeitgedächtnis"). Keep the English name + LSTM, as the glossary already does for Gated Recurrent Unit.
"Faltungsneuronales Netz" is not a German formation. Wikipedia lemma is the English name, glossed "faltendes neuronales Netzwerk". Alt.: faltendes neuronales Netz, Faltungsnetz; abbreviation CNN.
"Vollfaltungsnetz" is an invented compound. Alt.: Fully Convolutional Network (FCN).
"Impuls" is the physics translation of momentum; the optimizer term is "Momentum" (das) in German ML usage, and the glossary itself has "Heavy-Ball-Momentum".
See momentum.

Collides with step-size = "Schrittweite" (318 + 326 occurrences, both in optimization/ODE and CNN chapters). Keep "Schrittweite" for step size; use "Stride" (der) for convolutions. Wikipedia's CNN article does say "Schrittweite", so list it as alternative.
English left untranslated although convolution = Faltung everywhere else (transponierte/gruppierte/tiefenweise Faltung).
